prompt_parts: Transform the provided photograph into a complete hand-made artwork in that style. Use the photo only as source material for who is present, their pose, expression, hairstyle, clothing, and the spirit of their likeness. Redraw the face and body with the marks, color, and light of the selected style, so the result keeps the person's recognizable impression without the original photo's skin texture, lighting, or camera look. Keep the same number of people and their general relationships. Adapt the composition to {composition}, keep the main subject large and clear, and regenerate the whole background in the same art style. Keep everyone's natural face and body proportions: never stretch or squash the people to fit the frame, and fill any extra space by extending the background in the same style. The image should read clearly on a medium-resolution e-paper display, with bold shapes and clear contrast. The finished picture is one illustration, painting, print, drawing, or poster, with no title, caption, signature, watermark, logo, or readable lettering.
